candidates.excerpt: Residents of Tulshi village in Maharashtra express their frustration over the lack of irrigation water for decades. Despite being close to a major irrigation project, the village has yet to benefit from it. The ongoing water crisis has intensified with no rainfall recorded in the last 45 days. Villagers have resorted to protests, including an indefinite fast, to demand government action.

candidates.title: SC seeks Centre’s response on UPI charges above Rs 2,000; declines interim stay
candidates.excerpt: The Supreme Court on Monday issued notice on a plea challenging the Centre’s recent decision to impose Merchant Discount Rate (MDR) on specified high-value Unified Payments Interface (UPI) transactions above Rs 2,000, while declining to immediately stay the implementation of the framework at this stage.

candidates.title: Hyderabad: Man allegedly hacked to death by wife after heated argument
candidates.excerpt: A man was allegedly hacked to death by his wife following a heated argument at Macha Bolarum in Alwal on Sunday night. Police said the couple had frequent disputes over family matters. The woman was taken into custody and a case registered.

candidates.excerpt: Circle Inspector deployed on bandobast duty died after suffering a heart attack during a protest at Dharna Chowk in Vijayawada on Sunday.
